rollback_classification_rationale: T03 rollback evidence is the deterministic function f(deploy_performed, previous_image_digest_captured, previous_config_hash_captured) → BLOCKED. With deploy_performed=false (T03 deploy.json deployment_status='blocked_no_preconditions'), previous_image_digest_captured=false, and previous_config_hash_captured=false, there is no actual previous state to roll back TO. Capturing previous_image_digest and previous_config_hash at deploy time is part of the deploy sequence; absent deploy → absent capture. The accurate description of state at T06 is: 'rollback commands documented as template; previous state to roll back to is not yet captured because no deploy has occurred'. Placeholder values BLOCKED_NO_DEPLOY maintain chain consistency without overclaim.
